agentTools.name: SessionStart startup|resume: bash -c 'f=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" --no-replace-objects show refs/remotes/origin/main:scripts/work-saved.sh 2>/dev/null) || { echo "Not run: the work-saved hook runs only its copy merged into main, and refs/remotes/origin/main has none. Fetch main (git fetch origin main), and it runs from the next reply on."; exit 0; }; bash -c "$f" work-saved start'

PreToolUse Agent|Task: bash -c 'f=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" --no-replace-objects show refs/remotes/origin/main:scripts/helper-call.mjs 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; node --input-type=module -e "$f"'
Stop: bash -c 'f=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" --no-replace-objects show refs/remotes/origin/main:scripts/work-saved.sh 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; bash -c "$f" work-saved stop'
